rules.duplicate_projection: observationally indistinguishable; all optimal index candidates retained
rules.empty_projection: descriptors retained separately; never matching evidence
rules.equality: exact nonempty source-specific lowercase projected strings before hashing
rules.mandatory: sole possible index pair at its matched rank; conditional combinatorial status only
rules.order: original native source order within exact page ID; no page aliases
rules.pair_inventory: all index pairs on any maximum order-preserving pairing; no selected witness
rules.unmatched: minimum unmatched records per edition; not physical deletions or source errors
